purpose: Prepare crate 0.0.40 from a tree that carries the openssh closure campaign and its repairs but is otherwise unchanged from published 0.0.39: the swapped repr(C) field fix in the PKCS/7 stream callback, the BLAKE2 Stacked-Borrows repair, six legacy digest initialisers that now refuse instead of crashing, the alignment soundness guard on owner constructors, the master-secret cleansing owner, the resolver switch-bound correctness fix, and four ABI-contract-bounded edge classes. Version bump, Phase-2 rebuild from this exact source, atlas identity rebind with every measured row carried forward, documentation regeneration and packaging inventory. No publish, no commit, no push.
